observed_workspace_state: observed main SHA; generated outputs are excluded from release evidence

progress.definition: A family counts only when its mandatory Public v1 journey and applicable provider, security, and exact-candidate evidence are complete. P9 GenAI is out of scope; multi-user identity and administration belong to Ronin Pro.

release_rule: Ronin Public v1 remains incomplete while any active Public v1 capability family (P1-P8 or P10-P14) lacks an end-to-end supported path; P9 GenAI and multi-user Pro capabilities are excluded.

capabilities.summary: Durable Job/Run/Attempt lifecycle, local/container execution, leases, heartbeat, fencing, reclaim, resume, cancellation, evidence and project-scoped HTTP/CLI/SDK foundation.

Workspace/project persistence, authenticated create/read/update/archive workspace and project lifecycles with idempotency, audit and active-project filtering, project manifests, reproducible secret-free deployment manifest with canonical identity, Git identity, validated source URIs, detached checkout, dirty-worktree policy, safe revision evidence, local branch create/delete, remote fetch/update adapter, environments and deployment bindings exist; Studio and pyronin SDK cover project lifecycle, environment binding, Bundle actions, audited/idempotent governed pipeline execution and resource-scoped permission inspection; remote-provider qualification and complete Public v1 UI remain incomplete; multi-user membership belongs to Ronin Pro.

Provider-neutral connection/discovery/checkpoint contracts, governed local CSV/JSONL ingestion, bounded HTTP/REST and PostgreSQL snapshot reads, S3-compatible/Azure Blob JSON/JSONL sources, Apache Ozone S3 Gateway JSON/JSONL support with path-style SigV4 addressing, a fail-closed generic JDBC bridge profile with explicit watermark incremental reads, snapshot suppression, and content-addressed artifacts, plus public connector capability/plan/preview/checkpoint-health API, Studio actions, and SDK parity exist; production driver qualification and broader incremental source coverage remain incomplete.

Bounded Arrow/Parquet open-data and streaming publication paths, provider-neutral SQL/table contracts, optional local DuckDB engine with bounded relation lifecycle, shared query lifecycle adapter, provider-neutral query-engine contracts with discovery, local transport and Trino HTTP submit/poll/cancel transport, QueryFlux discovery and QueryFlux-to-Trino lifecycle adapters, bounded project-scoped fail-closed read-only SQL HTTP adapter/route, and optional Iceberg/Delta create-append-overwrite-read-inspect-delete adapters exist; external QueryFlux qualification, remote/catalog qualification, full format features, and broader SQL service remain incomplete.

Notebook execution and pipeline IR foundations, durable SQL editor revisions/history/bounded export, parameter schemas, deterministic project pipeline inventory, pipeline revision comparison/archive, authenticated pipeline revision import/list/detail/compare/archive exposed through an injected HTTP/OpenAPI/SDK port, and an authenticated pipeline-revision-to-workflow-run creation route with deterministic idempotency exist; bounded read-only SQL over registered Parquet is exposed through HTTP/OpenAPI/SDK/Studio, while worker/evidence lineage, PostgreSQL runtime qualification, complete notebook/SQL/pipeline public CRUD and broader authoring surfaces remain incomplete.

Durable workflow snapshots/task runs, lease-fenced attempts/retries/dependencies, deterministic task-to-Job planning, execution outbox/reconciliation, deployment-aware controller, timezone-aware cron, durable event inbox/delivery, cancellation, timeout enforcement, snapshot-safe bounded backfill, shared resource pools, generation-fenced leader authority, leader-guarded scheduler services, continuous daemon orchestration, graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM daemon entrypoint with fenced lease release, group backfill cancellation, fail-closed conditional branches with idempotent persisted decisions/skipped task state, authenticated schedule/event-trigger list/read/replace and event-ingest routes, Scheduler Studio authoring for schedules, event triggers, workflow runs, deliveries and backfills, durable scheduler adapters for notebook, SQL, Python-code, Data Engineering pipeline, quality-gate, connector-sync, graph-query, notification, semantic-refresh, ML nodes, optional leader-cycle notification dispatch, bounded SMTP/HTTPS webhook adapters, and durable notification retry/error recording exist. The combined daemon-crash-to-Docker-worker-to-terminal-reconciliation journey has focused qualification; complete controller recovery, notification-provider qualification, and broader operator conformance remain incomplete. PostgreSQL stores atomic workflow run/task snapshots, replay-safe branch decisions, generation-fenced scheduler leadership, persisted task-attempt leases and workspace resource pools. PostgreSQL has a schema-versioned, lease-fenced execution intent outbox with idempotent replay and terminal reconciliation, durable event delivery, snapshot-safe backfills, and workspace-scoped task-evidence lookup. A real-PostgreSQL process-kill test now covers dispatcher restart, idempotent replay, Job completion, and scheduler reconciliation with evidence. Webhook DNS resolution rejects non-public addresses and pins verified IPs through TLS. The ML scheduler adapter binds planned runs and result evidence to the canonical pipeline digest and full current lab digest; full daemon/controller recovery and scheduler conformance remain unqualified; scheduler HTTP routes remain unavailable pending full scheduler conformance.

Governed asset CRUD/revisions, versioned sensitivity and ownership metadata, glossary term authoring, bounded project-scoped catalog search, declared/observed lineage persistence with HTTP navigation, OpenLineage export plus bounded HTTP transport, and explicit selected-subgraph Bundle export/planning/atomic import exist; event standard certification and complete asset-family integration remain incomplete.

Ontology object/property/link/action schemas and persistence, bounded stable-key object-instance materialization, deterministic declared-link resolution with cardinality checks, bounded object-type/neighbor graph queries, SQLite graph persistence, durable idempotent action replay with conflict detection, authorized injected action dispatch, and authenticated public graph query/object/neighbor/action routes exist; provider production qualification remains incomplete.

A bounded, read-only RQL SELECT parser/executor now supports ontology-type filtering, equality predicates, explicit result limits, bounded multi-hop typed traversal, and typed property joins over materialized KnowledgeGraph views, with authenticated public query/object/neighbor routes; provider execution and production qualification remain incomplete.

Versioned contracts/rules/results and persistence exist; built-in null, unique, range, domain, row-count, freshness, referential, and explicitly injected sandboxed SQL/Python predicate execution plus provider-neutral scheduler-facing quality_gate release decisions, controller release-policy enforcement, quality-to-common-alert transition evaluation, authenticated contract read/replace and run/history/state APIs, pyronin SDK parity including contract authoring, and an accessible Quality Studio contract authoring, validation, dry-run, evidence/history and blocking-policy surface exist; provider production qualification remains incomplete.

Experiment/run/model/evaluation metadata, provenance persistence, deterministic tabular training, digest-verified registered inference, champion-model serving resolution, deterministic trial comparison, bounded numeric drift summaries, explicit feature-level drift threshold assessments, versioned feature definitions with dataset snapshots, workspace-scoped feature-definition HTTP routes, and pyronin SDK parity exist. Lab AssetRefs resolve to workspace-scoped digest-verified CSV/JSONL snapshots; durable async inputs above 1 MiB use ArtifactStore with size/digest validation; inline inputs enforce row, column, byte and canonical-JSON limits. Scheduled runs and async JobStore requests pin canonical pipeline/Lab digests. The v2 runner executes bounded custom candidate grids with independent prepare branches in stable topological order and durable checkpoint recovery. Final tabular and K-Means model results are materialized as verified bounded ArtifactStore objects, and an authorized terminal register stage registers successful executions as MLRun records and candidate model versions after rechecking artifact identity. CI qualifies S3-compatible artifact input/output, digest verification and safe unreferenced-object deletion against LocalStack. Scheduled dispatch passes the exact PipelineIR to runners and rejects runners that cannot execute it. Configurable arbitrary built-in DAG shapes, plugin-defined stages, broader feature engineering and algorithms, MLflow interoperability, network serving APIs, production-provider qualification and production qualification remain incomplete. Selective retry and downstream invalidation are implemented in the observed source.

Explicitly excluded from Ronin Public v1: no in-product model/provider invocation, prompts, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, tools, or agent runtime/API/Studio. Coding-agent skills are distributed for external agents and do not execute inside Ronin.

Safe semantic-model contracts, canonical model/query/tile/dashboard serialization, project-scoped SQLite model and dashboard persistence, parameterized metric compiler, calculated metrics, bounded provider-neutral multi-join planning/runtime/HTTP execution, SQL-backed metric runtime, dashboard CRUD/execution APIs, Studio UI and native semantic Bundle portability exist; export/import qualification and production qualification remain incomplete.

Kafka JSON polling with Ronin-owned offsets, durable SQLite compare-and-set checkpoints, checkpoint-safe micro-batch processing, identity transforms, idempotent Parquet sinks, bounded deterministic event-time windows with watermark/late-record classification, idempotent durable SQLite stream-table storage, deterministic stream-record to scheduler-event inbox integration, and project-scoped bounded health/lag projection including unseen partitions exist; production qualification remains incomplete.

Durable normalized metrics/events, configurable pending/firing/open/resolved alert state transitions with cooldown and acknowledgement persistence, deterministic alert and budget notification intents with durable delivery attempts/errors/backoff, bounded SMTP and HTTPS webhook delivery, dependency-free deterministic Prometheus text export, reusable execution instrumentation, LocalWorkerRuntime instrumentation callbacks in one-shot and continuous loops, usage pricing, actual-versus-estimated cost records, non-ledger forecast projections, budget evaluation, deny-new-work budget_gate decisions, and bounded explainable anomaly hooks exist; authenticated alert-rule/evaluation APIs, SDK parity and the Monitoring & Alerts Studio route are covered by static and Playwright smoke evidence; broader service adoption and production qualification remain incomplete.

Single-operator bearer authorization, transport policy, fail-closed policy checks, classification-aware actions, secret resolver ports, redaction, audit foundations, security reporting policy and release dependency evidence form the Public baseline. OIDC multi-user login, user/group provisioning, membership administration and multi-user role management belong to Ronin Pro; external-provider qualification remains incomplete.

Local/container/Compose foundation, PostgreSQL metadata adapter and healthcheck, wired PostgreSQL JobStore, single-node PostgreSQL lifecycle qualification, SQLite online backup/restore with path-bound manifests, PostgreSQL dump verification, S3-compatible artifact adapter, Kubernetes Job lifecycle adapter, forward-only migration qualification and recovery runbooks exist. Multi-user Helm, multi-worker server operation and scheduler HA are Ronin Pro capabilities; backup/restore, full scheduler conformance and external qualification remain incomplete.

Deterministic verified archive IO, shared verified archive reading across importers, semantic inventory, native project/connection round-trips with explicit runtime/secret remapping, atomic multi-object project+connection commit, workflow/schedule round-trips, quality-contract portability, governed ontology-definition portability, atomic SQLite semantic model/dashboard imports with exact replay, ML lab/pipeline and experiment/run/registered-model metadata portability, lakehouse table-metadata portability, and explicit catalog asset/revision/lineage selected-subgraph export/planning/atomic commit exist; PostgreSQL adapters for several domains, cross-domain import recovery, full native certification and public API surfaces remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-item translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-job translation with dependency and schedule mapping exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python-function translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python/SQL recipe translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Authenticated static Studio shell supports job listing, detail status, events, evidence, cancellation, navigation, packaged asset delivery, project-scoped read-only SQL, workspace creation, project creation/listing/archive, environment binding/editing, resource-scoped project permission inspection, Bundle actions, governed pipeline execution and a Monitoring & Alerts route backed by alert APIs; 77 Playwright route/accessibility/history/domain-journey checks pass; authoring editors, domain workflows, and complete Public v1 journeys remain incomplete.

Exact-head CI, security, Docker, status-consistency and release-packaging workflows are active; release qualification now generates and verifies candidate-bound SBOM/provenance evidence for wheel and sdist artifacts, alongside installed Studio smoke and accessibility checks. Main is protected with required PR approval, strict checks and no force-push/deletion. Product, provider-certification and legal/release evidence still requires incomplete or human-owned work.

human_decisions.summary: License/NOTICE/attribution conclusions and release approval remain human review decisions.
Mutation qualification remains retired; a new campaign requires an explicit product decision and plan.

next_critical_path: Keep construction/status docs synchronized with PUBLIC_V1_SCOPE.md.

Continue #102: coverage-release-gates applies a 90% line floor to 11 release-decision modules: strict gate (94%), aggregator (100%), artifact identity (96%), release evidence (91%), evidence emission (100%), installed-artifact evidence (96%), artifact qualification (96%), license qualification (97%), SBOM generation (96%), supply-chain evidence (97%), and mutation policy (97%). Review future decision modules against the policy.

Qualify PostgreSQL event/backfill/run/task-evidence adapters together, then qualify full daemon/controller recovery, restart behavior in the supported Compose profile, and broader operator/notification conformance. General production HA is outside the Public v1 contract.

Extend native Bundle support to the next executable canonical metadata family, preferring workflow/pipeline persistence if its canonical snapshot/store contracts preserve identity without deployment locators; then quality/ontology/ML as their contracts permit.
Finish storage ports for remaining domains, then qualify the wired PostgreSQL JobStore and the existing S3-compatible artifact adapter.
Implement Arrow/Parquet, a reference open lakehouse table profile and a reference SQL engine before broad vendor migration adapters.
Complete remote connectors and safe incremental checkpoint execution.
Expand Public v1 API and extend Web Studio from the verified job/evidence shell to documented domain APIs and authoring workflows.
Implement remaining quality, ontology/KG/RQL, ML, semantic, streaming, observability/alerts/FinOps and single-operator security runtime paths.
Keep multi-user identity and Kubernetes deployment on the Ronin Pro roadmap; implement the four certified migration profiles only after their canonical target capabilities execute end to end.
Keep exact-head CI/release qualification active, identify every claim by SHA, and do not claim Public v1 release readiness before all mandatory capabilities and human-owned evidence exist.
